title: IncuBrix CreatorOps Tamil

copy.headline: உங்களுக்கு பிடித்த உள்ளடக்கத்தை உருவாக்குங்கள்
copy.support: கருத்துகளை உரை, ஆடியோ மற்றும் வீடியோவாக மாற்றி அனைத்து தளங்களிலும் பகிரவும்.

concept: A warm, elegant hub-and-orbit visual metaphor showing a central glowing creation orb connected to four floating nodes representing discovery, generation, repurposing, and publishing, set against a rich deep plum and amber gradient background.

design_system.style: rich vector illustration with smooth gradients, soft glowing shadows, and clean geometric node shapes
design_system.lighting: top-left warm studio lighting casting soft dimensional shadows

composition.hero: A central luminous golden orb (radius 120px) positioned at center (x: 540, y: 850) with four interconnected orbital nodes placed at top, bottom, left, and right, each featuring a distinct warm coral and amber gradient fill and a soft drop shadow.
props: floating golden sparkles near the central orb
tiny geometric diamond shapes drifting upwards
soft glowing rings around the orbital paths
composition.background: Deep plum gradient background from top-left (3B183B) to dark burgundy (231123) with a large centered warm amber radial glow.
decor: a large faint semi-transparent abstract rounded rectangle in the upper third
a large soft curved wave shape at the bottom edge
